{{short description|American mathematician|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Stuart Sheldon Antman''' is an American mathematician. He is [[Distinguished University Research Professor]] at the [[University of Maryland]].<ref name="biosketch">[https://www.math.umd.edu/~ssa/cvshort.pdf Biographical sketch], retrieved 2014-12-20.</ref> His research involves [[continuum mechanics]], [[Elasticity (physics)|elasticity]], and [[nonlinear partial differential equation]]s.

Antman did his undergraduate studies at the [[Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute]], graduating in 1961.<ref name="biosketch"/>
He earned a Ph.D. in 1965 from the [[University of Minnesota]], under the supervision of William H. Warner.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|name=Stuart Sheldon Antman|id=31881}}.</ref>
He joined the [[New York University]] faculty in 1967, and moved to Maryland in 1972. He became Distinguished University Professor at Maryland in 2001, and Distinguished University Research Professor  in 2014.<ref name="biosketch"/>

Antman became a [[fellow]] of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] in 2009,<ref name="biosketch"/> and a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2012.<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2014-12-20.</ref> He was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] in 1978, and with [[John M. Ball]] he won the [[Theodore von Kármán Prize]] in 1999.<ref name="biosketch"/> In 1987 Antman won a [[Lester R. Ford Award]].<ref>{{cite journal|author=Antman, Stuart S.|title=Book Review of ''A Convergence of Lives: Sofia Kovalevskaia, scientist, writer, revolutionary'', by Ann Hibner Koblitz|journal=Amer. Math. Monthly|volume=93|year=1986|pages=139–144|url=http://www.maa.org/programs/maa-awards/writing-awards/book-review-of-a-convergence-of-lives-sofia-kovalevskaia-scientist-writer-revolutionary-by-a-hibner|doi=10.2307/2322722|jstor=2322722}}</ref> and in 2015 the Lyapunov Award from the American Society of Mechanical Engineers.

Antman is the author of the book ''Nonlinear Problems of Elasticity'' (Springer, 1995; 2nd ed., 2005).<ref>{{citation|doi=10.1137/1037152|journal=SIAM Review|title=Nonlinear Problems of Elasticity (Stuart S. Antman)|first=Michael|last=Renardy|volume=37|issue=4|page=637|year=1995}}.</ref><ref>Review of ''Nonlinear problems of elasticity'' by Massimo Lanza de Cristoforis (1996), {{MR|1323857}}. Updated for 2nd edition, same reviewer (2006), {{MR|2132247}}.</ref>
